generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers 1..N per table, unique, never NULL; parent tables filled before children.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Copy from parent key pool; allow NULL where column nullable; include parent rows without children and child rows with NULL FK.
generic_sampling_rules.real_numeric: Uniform in [min, max] from statistics, rounded to 2 decimals; include boundary values at listed literals and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_numeric: Uniform integer in [min, max] from statistics; include boundary values at listed literals and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Pick from a small pool of realistic values; include near-variants (case changes, one-character edits) of listed literals; allow NULL where nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Pick from a pool of realistic car names; include near-variants of listed literals; allow NULL where nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.enum_small: Pick uniformly from the listed enum values; allow NULL where nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For each nullable column, at least one NULL row per instance; share follows compact database null_rate (0.0 here, so plant a small share 5-10% to satisfy NULL targets).
generic_sampling_rules.duplicates_distinct: On DISTINCT-target columns, repeat values so duplicate share is 20-50%.
generic_sampling_rules.ties_order_limit: On ORDER-target columns, plant ties at rank 1 in both ASC and DESC directions.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_values: For each listed literal, generate the literal, one step below, one step above (numbers by step, text by near-variant).

targets.production.ID: parent rows without children; joins with data.ID, price.ID
targets.price.ID: parent rows without children; joins with data.ID, production.ID

targets.production.model_year: tie at rank 1, ASC/DESC, tie on COUNT(*)
